## Requirement
# Euclidean radial-polynomial VC-subgraph classes

## Goal

Build reusable Causalean covering certificates for bounded, compactly
supported radial-polynomial classes with a moving Euclidean center.  The
immediate dimension is two, but a finite-dimensional Euclidean statement is
preferred when it does not materially enlarge the proof.

## Provides

- A pseudo-dimension or polynomial L²-cover certificate for moving-center
  compactly supported Euclidean radial monomials.
- Finite Boolean/signed-arm variants and the finite linear-combination closure
  needed by bounded polynomial score classes.

## Statement / milestones

For fixed positive bandwidth bounds and fixed natural degree `p`, cover the
class generated by functions of the form

    z ↦ 1{a ≤ dist(z,x) ∧ dist(z,x) ≤ b}
          * (dist(z,x) / q)^k

where the center `x` varies, `0 < q`, `0 ≤ k ≤ p`, and the interval endpoints
are fixed multiples of `q`.  Signed-arm variants may be represented by a
finite Boolean index.  The useful public conclusion is either:

- an explicit `HasPseudoDimAtMost` bound depending only on Euclidean
  dimension and `p`; or
- directly a `HasPolynomialL2Cover` certificate with a positive constant
  envelope.

Also provide the finite-vector/linear-combination closure needed for

    indicator * radial_monomial_j
      * (bounded_response - Σₖ bₖ radial_monomial_k),

with coefficients in a fixed box.  Existing general algebra lemmas should be
used for this assembly rather than duplicated.

The certificate must be uniform over every probability measure `Q`, not only
Lebesgue or atomless measures.  Consequently a continuity/Lipschitz net in
the center is not sufficient: atomic `Q` can charge moving kernel boundaries.
The proof should work at the VC-subgraph/finite-trace level, using the
semialgebraic description of squared Euclidean distance and Boolean
combinations of ball/annulus predicates.  It must cover odd radial powers as
well as even ones.

## Standard reference

Standard VC-subgraph and semialgebraic growth bounds for finite-dimensional
families, combined with Sauer--Shelah and the pseudo-dimension-to-L²-cover
conversion. The result must be trace-level and uniform over atomic measures.

## Intended reuse

The immediate adapter is
`winsorizedScore_hasVCUniformEntropy` in
`CausalSmith/Stat/STAT_BddUniformLogPenalty_Research/Causal/EmpiricalProcess/EntropyChaining.lean`.
It supplies the `HasPolynomialEmpiricalL2Cover` field consumed by the already
proved `vcEntropy_chaining_bound`, then by `vcExpectedMaximalInequality` and
the frozen `cty_winsorized_score_maximal_bound`.

## May assume / must derive

May assume and reuse:

- `Causalean.Stat.Concentration.HasPseudoDimAtMost`
- `HasPseudoDimAtMost.hasPolynomialL2Cover`
- `HasPolynomialL2Cover.{neg,add,mul,finSum,finProd}`
- `linearParameterClass_hasPolynomialL2Cover`
- `HasVCAtMost` and `HasPolynomialL2Cover.mulIndicator`
- the finite-trace/growth-family and Sauer--Shelah machinery under
  `Causalean.Stat.Concentration.Covering`
- Mathlib finite-dimensional Euclidean distance identities and polynomial
  algebra

The paper-local theorem
`CausalSmith.Stat.BddUniformLogPenalty.euclidean_balls_vc` proves that closed
planar balls have VC index at most four, but the promoted result must not
import any `CausalSmith/*_Research` module.  Reprove or generalize the needed
ball trace lemma in neutral Causalean form.

Must derive the moving-center radial-polynomial finite-trace/covering
certificate, including odd powers, Boolean annulus/arm restrictions, and the
bounded finite-linear-combination closure uniformly over arbitrary probability
measures.

The promoted module must be Mathlib/Causalean-only, reachable from
`Causalean.lean`, documented and indexed, with zero `sorry`, `admit`, new
axioms, or paper imports.  Verify the full library build and `#print axioms`.

- Module prefix (one file per module): CausalSmith.Substrate.EuclideanRadialPolynomialVcSubgraph.<Name>

- `Trace.lean`: trace pullbacks, linear signs, Boolean combinations, and finite unions.
- `Geometry.lean`: Euclidean Borel space, ball/exterior classifiers, radial monomials, and pseudo-dimension APIs.
- `Cover.lean`: radial envelopes, parameter pullback, finite classes, general-domain radial covers, and signed arms.

## Decisions

- Keep conservative explicit bounds depending only on `d,p`; odd powers use monotonicity on nonnegative radii.
- Preserve one shared center across every score term via the internal-center `HasPolynomialL2Cover.pullback` theorem.

## Decisions

- Use a direct squared-distance affine lift plus finite Boolean trace counting, rather than formalizing the full Warren/Milnor semialgebraic theorem.

- Finite real-valued arms bounded by one subsume Boolean indicators and signed arms; no atomlessness or boundary-null hypothesis appears.
